name: generalizedEisenstein_aux
statement: R[X]} {p : ℕ} (hq_irr : Irreducible (q.map (algebraMap R K))) (hq_monic : q.Monic) (hf_lC : algebraMap R K f.leadingCoeff ≠ 0) (hf_prim : f.IsPrimitive) (hfmodP : f.map (algebraMap R K) = C (algebraMap R K f.leadingCoeff) * q.map (algebraMap R K) ^ p) (hg_div : g ∣ f) : ∃ m r, g = C g.leadingCoeff * q ^ m + r ∧ r.map (algebraMap R K) = 0 ∧ (m = 0 → IsUnit g)
